The chart contains 42 distinct categories (bars), not 26.
The vertical axis has a logarithmic scale, with major ticks at 1, 10, 100, and 1000, not a linear scale.

errors.evidence: The description of the scale intervals is incorrect and does not match the logarithmic scale shown in the figure (1, 10, 100, 1000).
The bar for 'O/s' (actually labeled O/s) has a value of approximately 40-50, not 183. The logarithmic scale shows it is less than 100.
The bar for 'Da/n' has a value of approximately 20-30, not 171.
The category label 'C/n' does not exist on the chart's x-axis.
The category label 'J/p' does not exist on the chart's x-axis. This might be a misreading of 'D/p'.
The category label 'D/d' does not exist on the chart's x-axis. This might be a misreading of 'Da/d' or 'Cv/d'.
The bar for 'O/d' aligns with the grid line for 10, so its value is 10, not 3.
The description incorrectly identifies the bar for 'O/d' as the smallest. Several other bars have values at or near 1 (e.g., 'Vt/vi', 'ADJ/d'), which are smaller than the value of 10 for 'O/d'.
The category label 'A/n-Cn/n' does not exist on the chart. The bar with the highest value is labeled 'A/n'.
The description states the maximum value is around 250. The actual maximum value, for the 'A/n' bar, is significantly higher, appearing to be around 400-500 on the logarithmic scale.
